statusReaderPolicy.readerGuidance: Automation must not require a root-level currentPhase. Use features[primaryFeature].phase for the canonical primary feature phase, features[featureName].phase for per-feature status, pipeline.currentPhase only as a session cursor, and recovery.currentPhase only if a future recovery block is present.
